After this PR, version bumps stay manual. 
Everything after a bump lands on main is mostly automated. The only other manual parts are:
* Merging a PR from main to release/v0, and clicking Publish on the autogenerated Changelog draft.


New procedure for making a new release:
1. open a PR to main that increments all version numbers
  1. A 
libraries/psibase/common/include/psibase/version.hpp — PSIBASE_VERSION_* macros (canonical; CI reads these)
CMakeLists.txt — set(PSIBASE_VERSION "X.Y.Z")
From rust/: ./scripts/set-version.sh x.y.z
Global search for the old version (package defs, etc. that set-version.sh misses)
Run a build so Cargo.lock picks up the new versions
After you open the PR (automatic):

crates-publish-dry-run runs on the PR. If version macros changed, it runs rust/scripts/publish.sh --dry-run and validates the log against the expected “sibling crate not on crates.io yet” pattern. If macros are unchanged, the job skips dry-run.
Optional manual confidence check before merge:

cd rust && ./scripts/publish.sh --dry-run
Step 2 — Manual: merge the version-bump PR to main
After merge (automatic):

cut-release.yml detects the version bump on main
Creates release/v0 at the pre-bump tip if that branch doesn’t exist yet
Opens a main → release/v0 PR (“Cut release from main”) if one isn’t already open
Note: PRs opened by GITHUB_TOKEN do not retrigger other workflows — that’s fine; the bump already built on main, and this PR is the merge/conflict gate.

Step 3 — Manual: merge the main → release/v0 PR
Resolve conflicts if any. This is the human gate for the release cut.

After merge (automatic):

cut-release.yml tags the merge commit (not the bump commit on main)
Tag name from macros: v0.x.y-pre when major is 0, else vX.Y.Z
Annotated tag message: psibase prerelease version vX.Y.Z or psibase version vX.Y.Z
ubuntu-builder.yml builds at the tag
create-draft-release.yml generates a changelog, prepends the v0 disclaimer when appropriate, attaches SDK artifacts, and creates a draft GitHub Release
Hand-pushed tags still work via on-tag.yml (same draft-release path).

Step 4 — Manual: review the draft release, then click Publish
Check changelog, artifacts, and prerelease flag.

After publish (automatic):

on-release.yml dispatches Docker image builds (cli.yml on image-builders)
Sends the Telegram notification
Runs rust/scripts/publish.sh (real publish to crates.io) using CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN
Quick reference
You do	Automation does
Bump versions + PR to main	Dry-run crate publish on bump PRs
Merge bump to main	Create/update release/v0, open cut PR
Merge cut PR into release/v0	Tag merge commit, build, draft GitHub Release
Publish the draft release	Docker builds, Telegram, crates.io publish
Removed from the old process
Manually creating release/v0
Manually merging main into the release branch locally
Manually creating/pushing the annotated tag
Manually running ./scripts/publish.sh after publish (now CI)
Manually adding the v0 disclaimer (draft release composes it)
